newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African industrials regain some losses at close.
newsitem.headline: S.African industrials regain some losses at close.

text.p: South African industrial shares regained some of their earlier losses just before the close of trade on short-covering after hitting day lows in the afternoon in the wake of weaker world markets, dealers said Friday.
However, gold shares drifted off their day highs at the close despite a firmer bullion price.

Industrials were hit by a poor Wall Street at open which lost 94.28 points to 6,755.75 points on Thursday night. The fall encouraged arbitrage activity in the morning with players selling stock and buying the future.

The industrial index recovered from 70 points down in afternoon trade to close 40.3 points off at 8,042.8. The overall index lost 33.3 points to 6,684.6 and the gold index was up 17.2 points to 1,370.4 points.
